proof.source_guard: All normalized source unchanged except moving exactly the three metadata assignments from IDLE&&in_accept to IDLE, and the separately recorded optional simulation assertion-domain correction.
proof.original_public_outputs: All compared without masks; every original name, direction and width checked.
proof.state_relation: All unchanged actual registers equal. Three lookup metadata bits equal outside IDLE; IDLE values may differ. Every current and next ADFF Q explicitly clamps to its original reset value. FF widths, types, polarity and reset descriptors match.
proof.transition: For every defined input and arbitrary state satisfying the relation, all original public outputs match and the complete next-state relation holds.
proof.reset_base: Active reset establishes the next-state relation without prior equality of the three metadata bits. Unreset lookup0/lookup1 and memories use common arbitrary initial contents for source equivalence; valid arrays reset invalid.
proof.memories: Actual two 256x32 memories, all parameters and initialization identical. Async read data are common arbitrary inputs. Read clock/reset/enable/address and write clock/enable/address ports compared completely. Write data compared per bit only where its corresponding write enable is asserted, proving identical RAM updates by induction.
proof.negative: Actual lookup_valid0 capture changed to valid1. SAT rejects with a real prior-relation-true, next-relation-false counterexample. This detects incorrect internal capture; it does not claim an immediate public-output difference. No timeout accepted.
proof.scope: Actual production default geometry and complete sampled transition relation. No external protocol assumptions, original output masking, downsized RAM, RTL timing changes, or arbitrary internal combinational cuts.
proof.limitations: No STA, hardware or full regression claim. The optional simulation-only assertion-domain correction is excluded by SYNTHESIS and requires a separate directed IDLE witness; this proof establishes equivalence in consuming phases.

idle_witness.scope: Actual512-word baseline and qualified candidate with assertions enabled. Three initial physical reads2,514,0, unowned-IDLE address change, then legitimate cache-hit read2. No private writes, forces, or explicit RAM initialization.

directed.limitations: Directed CPU evidence and exact queue proof; no full machine regression, STA or hardware claim. Icarus/Verilator traces are compared before/after per simulator, not across four-state versus two-state models.

prefetch_onehot.review: Independent review approved exact source guard, every state/public bit, transition/reset/flush and real negative, portable tool delta and source-bound directed evidence.
prefetch_onehot.scope: Actual six-byte queue, all original public outputs including empty consume_data, legal post-reset head relation and common arbitrary storage. No external protocol assumptions. Strict DUT lint and dual-simulator full-CPU fetch fidelity with byte-identical traces. No full regression, STA or hardware claim.

receipt.scope: Exactly four bounded active kernels before and four after. Actual CPU/bridge/memory-owner/cache/SDRAM-controller/pin-model path; production cache geometry. No disabled-cache controls, full regression, or hardware claim. Profiles compare architectural signatures, exact CPU cycles, bus/owner latency accounting and actual pin-model READ/WRITE command counts, not a raw waveform transaction trace.
receipt.source_delta_guard: Only SHA-bound formally equivalent binary-to-onehot head rewrite differs; every other compiled source, firmware, expectation, script and configuration input identical.
receipt.harness_delta_guard: Compilation/setup prefix of unchanged test_checkit_directed.sh retained exactly except explicit source root and -j4->2. Only four active commands appended with explicit production geometry/runtime flags and original unchanged expectations. Original P03off loop/comparison aggregator excluded.

active_kernels.scope: Four full logs byte-identical with actual CODE512/DATA512, posted writes, SDRAM owner and physical pin model; all 61 before/after input hashes checked. Only the queue source changes in this run; no separately recorded transaction waveform.
